verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents a comprehensive REST API with full parity to the web client, OAuth 2.0 authentication, documented rate limits, and a published OpenAPI spec, all confirmed live; this is exactly the documented public API needed for AI-native/programmatic control. missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration beyond vendor docs (the openapi.json well-known probes 404, though the vendor's own OpenAPI download link is separately verified live).
